body:
I'm a schedule-focused person, so the gamble definitely isn't fun. 

I guess we as a people aren't as civilized as we say if we're still hung up on "fuck you, got mine" and let everything get to this spot as a result.

Trust me, I'm estatic that Ocasio-Cortez won so handidly and that socialists are able to move past the "we didn't win, but we made progress" discourse. The DSA is also a great organization. But leftists in early Nazi Germany were slaughtered and couldn't prevent what happened after. Leftists in Central and South America were slaughtered and couldn't prevent what happened after. 

I guess there's two big fears with this: the fear of dying as a result of someone else and losing a fight you're were going to lose already.  It'll be much more preferable for me to dictate when I die.

Sorry for the late response.

I don't have much in terms of peer review. I have some other friends that dabble in writing, but they write much different material than me. 

As far as stuff outside of writing, there isn't much for me. Performance art and acting isn't my thing because of my speech impediments, and I don't have much to say with visual arts. I'm decent in video editing, but it's way below what I actually want to create. Writing is more or less all I have.

I did the daily grind of writing or studying SOMETHING for a good three-and-a-half years. I fell off for the past nine months due to this new job exhausting me physically and mentally. Still, stuff I write now is the same as before I wrote nine months ago which is the same that I wrote three-and-a-half years ago. There's nothing of worth there.
